privacy.title: Sawaka Privacy Policy
privacy.s1P1: This Privacy Policy explains how Sawaka collects, uses, stores, and protects personal information when visitors and users access the platform.
privacy.s1P2: By using Sawaka, you acknowledge that your personal information may be processed as described in this policy.
privacy.s2P1: Sawaka may collect the following types of personal information, depending on how you use the platform:
privacy.s2Item3: Supplier or business profile information, including descriptions, categories, and contact details;
privacy.s2Item6: Technical information such as browser type, device information, IP address, and usage logs.
privacy.s2P2: Some information is provided directly by users; other information may be collected automatically when the platform is accessed.
privacy.s3Item2: Display supplier and project-related information on the platform;
privacy.s3Item3: Support platform features and improve usability;
privacy.s3Item4: Generate project ideas and related suggestions;
privacy.s3Item6: Communicate with users when necessary regarding their account or platform activity.
privacy.s4P1: Personal information is stored using platform databases and technical service providers used to operate Sawaka.
privacy.s4P2: Access to stored information is limited to authorized persons or systems needed to operate, maintain, and improve the platform.
privacy.s4P3: Sawaka takes reasonable measures to protect stored information, though no system can guarantee absolute security.
privacy.s5P1: Sawaka keeps personal information only as long as reasonably necessary to:
privacy.s5Item1: Operate the platform and support user accounts;
privacy.s5Item4: Meet applicable legal or operational obligations.
privacy.s5P2: Users may request assistance regarding deletion or correction of their personal information by contacting Sawaka through the methods described in this policy.
privacy.s6P1: Sawaka does not sell personal information.
privacy.s6P2: Information may be visible to other users when intentionally published as part of a supplier profile, project, or community interaction on the platform.
privacy.s6P3: Information may also be processed by technical service providers that help operate Sawaka, such as hosting, database, or infrastructure providers. These providers are expected to handle information only as needed to support platform operations.
privacy.s7Item1: Providing accurate information to the best of their knowledge;
privacy.s7Item2: Ensuring that information they publish on the platform does not violate the rights or privacy of others;
privacy.s7Item3: Protecting the confidentiality of their account credentials;
privacy.s7Item4: Reviewing what they choose to share publicly through supplier profiles, projects, or community interactions.
privacy.s8P1: Sawaka may use submitted information to support AI-assisted project idea generation, supplier discovery, and resource estimation.
privacy.s8P2: AI-generated outputs may rely on assumptions, including typical products associated with supplier categories, average local market prices, publicly available information, and information voluntarily provided by users.
privacy.s8P3: AI-generated suggestions are provided for informational and exploratory purposes only. Users should verify AI-generated outputs before making business decisions.
privacy.s9P1: For the MVP, Sawaka may use only essential technical cookies or similar technologies needed for authentication, security, and platform operation.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.subtitle: Sawaka is more than a marketplace. It is a collaborative platform designed to transform ideas into opportunities by connecting entrepreneurs, artisans, makers, suppliers, and communities.
mission.s1Intro: Everywhere, motivated people carry project ideas — yet many do not know where to start. They often lack essential elements to move forward:

why.noStart: practical information to structure and launch a project;
why.noEcosystem: access to a local ecosystem where they can find the right people and resources.

mission.s1Closing: Many worthwhile projects never materialize because it is hard to find the right environment to move forward. Sawaka was created to bridge that gap.
mission.s2Intro: Sawaka helps people who want to create, learn, and build businesses to:

help.discoverIdeas: discover project ideas suited to their context;
help.findResources: find practical information and real-world feedback;
help.collaborate: collaborate instead of working in isolation.

mission.s2Closing: At the heart of our approach: helping people turn limited resources into concrete, realistic opportunities.
mission.s3Intro: Unlike traditional marketplaces or professional social networks, Sawaka combines:

difference.practicalGuidance: practical guidance to move forward concretely.

mission.s3Closing: The platform is designed around concrete collaboration — not networking alone.
mission.s4Intro: Sawaka brings together complementary profiles within a single local creation ecosystem.

mission.s5Title: What you can do on Sawaka
mission.s5Intro: The platform offers tools to move from inspiration to action:

ideas.title: Explore project ideas
ideas.desc: Discover entrepreneurial or creative paths suited to your context and means.

suppliers.title: Discover suppliers
suppliers.desc: Find artisans, retailers, and organizations able to meet your needs.

materials.title: Find raw materials
materials.desc: Locate essential materials for your creations and prototypes.

tools.title: Locate tools
tools.desc: Identify tools available for purchase, rental, or within your community.

experience.title: Share experience
experience.desc: Contribute to collective knowledge by sharing what you have learned in the field.

collaborate.title: Collaborate on projects
collaborate.desc: Join ongoing initiatives or find people to move forward together.

showcase.title: Present your work
showcase.desc: Showcase your achievements and draw attention from the community.

network.title: Build your professional network
network.desc: Connect with peers, mentors, and local partners.

learn.title: Learn from other entrepreneurs
learn.desc: Benefit from practical advice and real-world experience.

mission.s5Closing: New capabilities will continue to be added progressively, based on community needs.

collaboration.title: Collaboration
collaboration.desc: We prioritize mutual support and complementarity over isolated competition.

knowledge.title: Knowledge sharing
knowledge.desc: Each person's experience enriches the whole and accelerates collective learning.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.desc: Sawaka is designed to be simple, inclusive, and usable without complex infrastructure.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.desc: We communicate openly about our goals, limitations, and progress.

learning.title: Continuous learning
learning.desc: The platform evolves with its users by testing, listening, and improving.

localImpact.title: Local impact
localImpact.desc: We support initiatives that create value for nearby communities.

innovation.title: Innovation
innovation.desc: We explore new ways to connect ideas, skills, and local resources.

community.title: Community
community.desc: Sawaka is built with and for people who want to create together.

mission.s7Intro: Over time, Sawaka aims to become a trusted ecosystem helping local communities create sustainable economic opportunities. We are exploring directions such as:

vision.knowledge: organized, community-driven knowledge accessible to all;
vision.bi: business intelligence tools to better understand local trends and needs;
vision.ai: AI-assisted project exploration grounded in relevant local data;
vision.mapping: mapping of creation ecosystems at a territorial scale.

mission.s7Closing: These directions represent long-term ambitions — they are not commitments to specific products.
mission.s8Intro: Sawaka is supported by a non-profit association. Its role is to:

association.support: support the project's development in the public interest;
association.initiatives: promote community initiatives related to creation and entrepreneurship.
